youtube.baslik: Why do tones in a hearing test last a second or two? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The ear sums the energy of a short sound over about 200 to 300 milliseconds; this is called temporal integration, and tones shorter than this have higher thresholds. In pure-tone audiometry, tones are presented for about 1 to 2 seconds to stay well above this integration time.
